companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Careers page URLs (e.g. https://boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb, https://jobs.lever.co/palantir, https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/openai) or plain company slugs (e.g. airbnb). Plain slugs are tried on every supported platform.

keywords.title: Title keywords
keywords.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these words (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all jobs.

locations.title: Location contains
locations.description: Keep jobs whose location contains any of these (e.g. London, United Kingdom, Remote).

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs marked or described as remote.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs posted or updated in the last N days (0 = no limit). Some platforms only expose 'updated' dates.

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: Adds the job description as plain text and HTML.
